title: OpenAI Appoints Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs
summary: OpenAI names Jill Hazelbaker Chief Corporate Affairs Officer to lead global communications and corporate positioning strategy in 2026.
body_markdown:
**Officially launched on November 3, 2026.**


#### 💡 TL;DR


- OpenAI appointed Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer to oversee global communications and corporate positioning strategy.
- Hazelbaker brings extensive experience from senior leadership roles at Uber and Google, navigating high-stakes public affairs challenges.
- The appointment strengthens OpenAI's executive team as the company scales its enterprise partnerships and regulatory engagement worldwide.


[OpenAI](https://emergent.sh/learn/what-is-openai) has appointed Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer, effective immediately. Hazelbaker will lead the company's global communications, corporate positioning, and public affairs strategy as OpenAI continues scaling its enterprise partnerships and navigating complex regulatory landscapes worldwide. The appointment, officially announced on November 3, 2026, adds critical leadership depth to the company's executive team during a period of rapid growth.


## Leadership Background and Experience


Hazelbaker brings two decades of strategic communications experience to OpenAI. Most recently, she served as Senior Vice President of Marketing and Public Affairs at Uber, where she managed global communications during the company's expansion into autonomous vehicles and regulatory challenges across multiple markets. Before Uber, Hazelbaker held senior roles at Google, overseeing policy communications and government relations efforts.


Her track record includes navigating high-stakes public debates around technology regulation, privacy frameworks, and corporate accountability. At Uber, she led the company's reputation recovery efforts following management controversies and built relationships with policymakers in over 50 countries. This experience positions her to address similar challenges as OpenAI faces increased scrutiny from regulators, advocacy groups, and enterprise customers evaluating AI governance standards.


## Strategic Priorities for Corporate Affairs


In her new role, Hazelbaker will oversee three core functions: external communications, corporate brand strategy, and stakeholder engagement. According to OpenAI's announcement, her immediate priorities include strengthening the company's narrative around AI safety commitments, expanding enterprise customer communication channels, and building proactive relationships with global policymakers.


The corporate affairs function will also coordinate cross-functional efforts between OpenAI's research, product, and policy teams to ensure consistent messaging on model capabilities, safety protocols, and deployment guidelines. Hazelbaker will report directly to CEO Sam Altman and join the company's executive leadership team.


## Release Date and Organizational Context


The appointment was officially announced on November 3, 2026, following a multi-month search process. OpenAI created the Chief Corporate Affairs Officer position specifically to consolidate communications and corporate strategy under unified leadership. The role reflects the company's recognition that managing public perception and stakeholder relationships requires dedicated C-suite attention as AI technologies move from research labs into widespread commercial deployment.


This hire follows other recent executive appointments at OpenAI, including national security advisors and enterprise sales leaders, signaling the company's shift toward institutional-scale operations and governance structures.


## Industry Context and Competitive Landscape


The appointment comes as AI companies face mounting pressure to demonstrate responsible development practices and transparent communication with stakeholders. Competitors including Anthropic and Google DeepMind have similarly invested in policy and communications leadership to navigate regulatory uncertainty and public debate around AI safety, job displacement concerns, and algorithmic accountability.


Hazelbaker's experience managing corporate reputation during technology controversies positions OpenAI to address criticism more effectively. Her background in both tech policy and brand strategy provides the company with capabilities to engage regulators, customers, and civil society groups simultaneously across different geographies and regulatory regimes.


## What This Means


OpenAI's decision to appoint a dedicated Chief Corporate Affairs Officer signals the company's maturation from AI research lab to global enterprise technology provider. Hazelbaker's mandate extends beyond traditional public relations to encompass strategic positioning, stakeholder alignment, and reputational risk management. As OpenAI deploys increasingly capable AI systems into sensitive enterprise environments and consumer applications, her leadership will shape how the company communicates capabilities, limitations, and safety commitments to diverse audiences. The appointment acknowledges that technical excellence alone cannot sustain market leadership in an industry facing unprecedented public scrutiny and regulatory complexity.
